request.prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the fambaa. Fambaas were large herbivorous amphibians most often found in swamps, with the scaly hide of reptiles, and were used as beasts of burden. Body plan: a huge, low-slung swamp amphibian with reptile-scaled hide and a broad, flat, heavy back built for hauling loads, wide and level like a platform for cargo. The neck is short and thick, heavily muscled and carried forward and low, so the broad heavy head projects forward at about shoulder height, like a big lizard grazing. The broad, lipless mouth is closed or only slightly parted, with a neutral, heavy-jawed expression and naturally resting corners; no tongue is visible. The lower jaw carries a short pale tusk on each side near the front of the mouth, jutting upward past the upper lip, clearly visible from the front and in side profile. All four legs are thick, columnar pillars that keep their full thickness from thigh to foot, ending in broad, round, elephant-like feet with short, blunt, dark claws and heavy skin folds at the joints; the hind legs are as bulky as the forelegs. A long, thick-based, tapering scaly tail extends from the rump: in side view it trails straight out behind the hips, in rear view, seen from behind, it hangs down visibly between the haunches, and it turns consistently with the body on every facing. Blue-green swamp colouring, with a frilled crest along the head and neck. Keep the palette, scaled hide, broad back, tusks and frilled crest as in the previous render. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, clean dark outline, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible including the full tail, nothing cut off. Fully transparent background with only the creature drawn.

East: a side profile of the same animal. The body is long and low with a long thin tapering tail to the left, the head is to the right with a bulging eye and toothy jaw, and it stands on squat legs.
